finals.report:
**#68 external-effect cut — Alt B, no phase journal.** Grounded at 9967af1: durable binding lives in `isswf-job.mjs` (repo, inputSha, targetBase, jobPath), process metadata in `worker-lifecycle.mjs`, and `native-recovery.mjs` already returns `candidateHashes` plus `remoteEffects:"not-reconciled"`. No branch/PR/issue code or remote call exists.

**Minimal data / logical key.** Effect facts live in the existing runs store: `<store>/effects/<repoKey>/<logicalJobRef>/<operation>.json` (intent once, then observed resolution) — a subdir, no service/registry. `logicalJobRef` = repo + coordinator-assigned committed job identity; `operation` ∈ branch-push, issue-open, pr-open. Candidate SHA is immutable intent payload, never key material: a changed candidate/input/attempt reuses the same branch, marker and PR identity. Branch name, commit trailer and body marker derive deterministically from the key. Current bindings carry no logical ref, so missing identity blocks external reconciliation; a fresh attemptID never implies freshness.

**Source of truth / ownership.** Remote state is authoritative; the local record only preserves what to query. The live attempt is the only effect writer; `read`/`reconcile` stays read-only and never repeats effects. Any push/PR/issue call requires a concrete per-effect operator grant; the current grant (reviewed `origin/main` push) does not cover it, so execution stays blocked.

**Caller / interface.** Minimal `tools/external-recovery.mjs`, consumed by the normal coordinator entry `isswf-job.mjs read|reconcile`: `resolveLogicalKey(binding) → {key}|blocked` and `reconcileEffect({key, operation, intent, transport}) → {status: reconciled|absent|blocked, effectRef?, reason}`. `transport` is an injected callback (`query`, `invoke`); no dispatcher, daemon or registry.

**Crash states.** Pre-invocation: query exact branch/marker; absent means not attempted. Push response lost: exact ref+SHA match reconciles; divergence, zero, ambiguous or query error block. PR response lost: exactly one head/base+marker match with matching intent reconciles and records the URL; zero or multiple block. Changed candidate under the same key updates the existing effect, never creates a second PR. Issues follow marker query.

**Versus a phase journal:** B performs no per-phase writes during the effect; local facts are one intent index keyed by stable logical ref, so a fresh attempt/input/candidate cannot fork PR identity. Cost: more blocks under remote ambiguity and one read-only module.

**Tests, offline first.** Fixture transport over a disposable bare repo; a real fixture process performs the remote write and is SIGKILLed before and after publishing its response. Assert exact-match reconciliation creates no duplicate; lost/zero/ambiguous queries block with no retry; same key + changed candidate keeps one PR identity; missing key blocks; new attemptID cannot bypass. No GitHub/gh call is executed or claimed as integrated.

**Cannot prove.** No exactly-once; OPS-04 convergence only when exactly identifiable, OPS-05 blocks the rest. Remote search eventual consistency means a zero result never authorizes retry. Real GitHub semantics stay unproven until a named grant; this designs the external cut only and does not close #68.
